title: City Council District 9
statement: Laurel and Uptown are holding steady, and that's not luck — that's the result of consistent, focused attention on the fundamentals. With no proposals touching my turf and no pressing conditions demanding intervention, the right move this cycle is restraint. I'm not going to manufacture motion for the sake of looking busy. I've got my eye on the sick-resident counts in both neighborhoods, and I'll stay ready to act the moment those numbers trend the wrong way. Sometimes the strongest statement a councilmember can make is that the work is working — and my job now is to not let good work get distracted.
